questions.question: The value of 2sin30° + 5cos60° + 3sin180° is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Directly substitute the **standard trigonometric values**:

sin 30° = 1/2, cos 60° = 1/2, and sin 180° = 0.

Expression: 2(1/2) + 5(1/2) + 3(0)

⇒ 1 + 2.5 + 0 = 3.5 = 7/2.

**∴ The correct answer is 7/2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** 2sin30° + 5cos60° + 3sin180°

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c270e5e57a86b4d9fec994f20088dea5adefb23d65cdd2ab750d9e418a7c3c30.png] 

Using the **trigonometric ratios** for standard angles:

⇒ Value of **sin 30°** = 1/2

⇒ Value of **cos 60°** = 1/2

⇒ Value of **sin 180°** = 0

Now, substitute these values into the given expression:

⇒ 2 × (1/2) + 5 × (1/2) + 3 × 0

⇒ 1 + 5/2 + 0

⇒ (2 + 5) / 2

⇒ 7/2

Thus, the final evaluated result is 7/2, which matches **Option 4**.

**∴ The correct answer is 7/2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Complementary Angles Property

For any angle θ, sin θ = cos(90° − θ). This is why **sin 30° = cos 60° = 1/2**.

Values of sin(nπ)

The sine of any integer multiple of 180° (π radians) is always zero. ∴ **sin 0° = sin 180° = sin 360° = 0**.

Standard Trigonometric Table

Always remember the basic values: **sin 45° = 1/√2**, **cos 30° = √3/2**, and **tan 45° = 1** for quick calculations.</p

questions.question: A hard disk is an example of which type of data storage device?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Secondary storage**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hard disks** are classified as secondary storage devices because they are not directly accessed by the CPU.
 
• They provide non-volatile storage, meaning data is retained even when the computer is turned off.
 
• Hard disks are used to store large amounts of data, programs, and files that are not currently in use by the system.
 
• They offer a higher storage capacity compared to primary storage like RAM.
 
• Data on a hard disk is accessed via an interface like SATA or SSD.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Secondary storage** refers to devices that store data persistently and are not directly accessed by the CPU. Examples include hard disks, SSDs, and external storage devices.

 
 

 Storage Type
 Description
 
 
 
 

 Primary Storage
 Includes RAM and cache memory, which are directly accessed by the CPU.
 
 

 Secondary Storage
 Includes hard disks and SSDs, which store data persistently and are not directly accessed by the CPU.
 
 

 Off-line Storage
 Refers to storage devices that are not connected to the computer, such as USB drives and external hard drives.
 
 

 Tertiary Storage
 Used for large-scale data storage and archival, such as tape drives and optical jukeboxes.

questions.question: A is only 40% as efficient as B. C is 50% as efficient as A and B together. If C alone completes the task in 30 days, then A, B and C together can complete the task in:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A's efficiency = 0.4 × B's efficiency

C's efficiency = 0.5 × (A's efficiency + B's efficiency)

C alone completes the task in 30 days

Formula Used:

Efficiency = Work / Time

**Calculation:**

Let B's efficiency be 1 unit/day.

⇒ A's efficiency = 0.4 × B's efficiency = 0.4 units/day

Since C's efficiency = 0.5 × (A's efficiency + B's efficiency),

⇒ C's efficiency = 0.5 × (0.4 + 1) = 0.5 × 1.4 = 0.7 units/day

C completes the task in 30 days,

⇒ Work = C's efficiency × Time = 0.7 units/day × 30 days = 21 units

Combined efficiency of A, B, and C together = 0.4 units/day + 1 unit/day + 0.7 units/day = 2.1 units/day

Time taken by A, B, and C together to complete the task: = 21 units / 2.1 units/day = 10 days.

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**

questions.question: Ravikant cycles at a speed of 12.5 km/h and walks at a speed of 3 km/h. To cover a distance of 40 km by cycle and walk both, Ravikant took 7 hours. How many of these hours were spent cycling?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__
Apply **Alligation** on speeds to find the **Time Ratio**.

Average speed = 40 km ÷ 7 hours = 40/7 km/h.

Alligation: (Cycling: 12.5) − (Avg: 40/7) vs (Avg: 40/7) − (Walking: 3).

Ratio of Time = (40/7 − 3) : (12.5 − 40/7) ⇒ (19/7) : (47.5/7) ⇒ 19 : 47.5 ⇒ 2 : 5.

Total time parts = 2 + 5 = 7 units. Since total time is 7 hours, 1 unit = 1 hour.

**∴ The correct answer is 2 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8fd06edab00f489f9c082c6de3cca2838b8d488cdc1fcc5f26421444d289c731.png] 
**Given:** Cycling speed = **12.5 km/h**, Walking speed = **3 km/h**, Total distance = **40 km**, Total time = **7 hours**.

**Formula Used:** Distance = Speed × Time

Let the time spent **cycling** be **t** hours.

Then, time spent **walking** = **(7 − t)** hours.

⇒ Distance by Cycle + Distance by Walk = Total Distance

⇒ (12.5 × t) + [3 × (7 − t)] = 40

⇒ 12.5t + 21 − 3t = 40

⇒ 9.5t = 40 − 21

⇒ 9.5t = 19

⇒ t = 19 ÷ 9.5

⇒ t = 2 hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 2 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

When alligation is applied to speeds, the resulting ratio is always the ratio of the **Time** taken for each part of the journey.

Average Speed

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time. In this case, 40 ÷ 7 ≈ 5.71 km/h.
